provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Agricola Revised Edition rulebook (Lookout Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Each player: 5 people, 4 stables, 15 fences and a farmyard board; one person in each of the 2 wood rooms
Random starting player: they get 2 food, everyone else 3
Remove occupations not used at your player count ([3+], [4]); deal each player 7
Game board plus the extension for your player count, correct side up
Clay/stone room tiles by the board; wood room tiles in two halves, one rooms up, one fields up
Major improvements on the supply board
Shuffle the 14 action space cards, sort by back into 6 stacks, stack with stage 1 on top
Animals, building resources, crops and food as the general supply; begging markers to the side
Each round starts by revealing the top action space card
